scheme2_name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana - Short Term Training (PMKVY)

comparisons.scheme1_value: Crop insurance to protect farmers from financial loss due to natural disasters, pests, and diseases
comparisons.scheme2_value: Skill training and certification to help unemployed youth and school dropouts get jobs

comparisons.scheme1_value: All farmers (including tenant farmers and sharecroppers) growing notified crops in notified areas
comparisons.scheme2_value: Indian nationals aged 15-45 years who are unemployed or have dropped out of school/college

comparisons.scheme1_value: Low-cost crop insurance (farmer pays 1.5%-5% premium, government pays rest); claims within 2 months; covers natural disasters, pests, diseases, post-harvest losses, and prevented sowing
comparisons.scheme2_value: Free/subsidised training in industry-relevant skills; soft skills, entrepreneurship, and digital literacy; accidental insurance; placement assistance; travel cost; boarding/lodging support; post-placement tracking

comparisons.scheme1_value: Photo ID (Aadhaar/PAN/Voter ID), address proof, bank passbook, land ownership certificate (RoR/LPC), crop declaration
comparisons.scheme2_value: Aadhaar card (mandatory at enrolment) and role-specific documents as required by the awarding body

comparisons.scheme1_value: Online at pmfby.gov.in (register, log in, fill form, upload documents, pay premium) or offline via CSC; offline application also available
comparisons.scheme2_value: Contact nearest Training Centre (find at pmkvyofficial.org/trainingcenter) or register online at skillindiadigital.gov.in

comparisons.scheme1_value: Must apply within ~2 weeks of the start of each sowing season (Kharif/Rabi); exact cut-off dates notified per state on pmfby.gov.in. Missing deadline means NO cover for that season [CRITICAL]
comparisons.scheme2_value: Training runs year-round; no fixed deadline. Batches start throughout the year—check with your nearest centre

comparisons.scheme1_value: Farmer pays 1.5% (Rabi crops), 2% (Kharif crops), or 5% (commercial/horticultural crops); government subsidises rest. Full premium paid by government in NE States, J&K, and Himachal Pradesh
comparisons.scheme2_value: Free for most candidates. Higher-level courses (NSQF Level 5+) may be fee-based, but weaker/marginalised sections continue to receive support

comparisons.scheme1_value: Must have insurable interest in the crop; valid land ownership/tenure document; must apply before seasonal cut-off; cannot have received compensation for same loss from another source
comparisons.scheme2_value: Age 15-45 years; Indian national; Aadhaar card required; Aadhaar-linked bank account required; meet job-role criteria

comparisons.scheme1_value: Non-notified areas not covered; losses outside crop cycle not covered; farmer negligence/non-compliance with practices leads to rejection; non-payment cancels coverage; post-harvest cover only 14 days [CRITICAL: Missing seasonal deadline = no cover]
comparisons.scheme2_value: Minimum 70% attendance mandatory to appear in assessments; Aadhaar mandatory at enrolment [CRITICAL: No Aadhaar = cannot enrol]

comparisons.scheme1_value: Claims targeted within 2 months of harvest; uses satellite imaging, drones, and mobile apps for loss estimation
comparisons.scheme2_value: Training duration varies by job role; assessment after training; placement support ongoing post-certification

comparisons.scheme1_value: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
comparisons.scheme2_value: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

recommendation:
**These are COMPLETELY DIFFERENT schemes for different needs:**

🌾 **Choose PMFBY if:** You are a farmer and want to protect your crops from weather damage, pests, and natural disasters. Apply during the 2-week window before each sowing season in your state.

💼 **Choose PMKVY if:** You are unemployed or a school/college dropout (aged 15-45) and want FREE job training in skills like construction, retail, hospitality, etc. Visit your nearest training centre anytime.

⚠️ **DISCLAIMERS:**
- This is AI guidance based on official scheme documents, NOT an official notification.
- For final decisions, verify on official portals: pmfby.gov.in (PMFBY) and skillindiadigital.gov.in (PMKVY).
- For legal/policy questions, contact your state agriculture department (PMFBY) or nearest Skill India centre (PMKVY).
- Both schemes have CRITICAL deadlines/conditions—read the "Hidden Conditions & Rules" above carefully.
